Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XI OF 2005
ACT XI OF 2005
Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act further to amend the Punjab
Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961.
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 9th July, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:-‑
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
